title: High-temperature mechanical properties and deformation behavior of carbides reinforced TiNbTaZrHf composite
process_description: prepared by mechanical alloying of Nb, Ta, Zr, Hf and TiC powders with ball-to-powder mass ratio of 10:1 for 12 hours at 350 rpm under argon atmosphere, followed by densification via spark plasma sintering at 1500°C for 5 minutes under 50 MPa pressure
